culpritSource.quote: The culprit is Hiroyuki Tomonaga. As proof, though the bombs were equipped with timers, they were rigged to be controlled by a remote. According to forensics, this would work only upto a range of 30 meters. So, the culprit had to be close to the bomb to speed up the timer. Furthermore, the culprit had to coordinate the incoming texts with Kogoro's actions. Tomonaga volunteered to go with the Police to achieve this. He suggested Takuji Hirukawa to attack the transport truck carrying the money while making it look like he was out to avenge his brother.

motive.zhHans: 他怂恿 Takuji Hirukawa 去袭击运载钞票的运输车，同时把自己伪装成在为哥哥报仇的样子。被害人：Takuji Hirukawa 年龄：38岁 伤势：爆炸犯人：Hiroyuki Tomonaga Hiroyuki 试图通过用爆炸杀死 Takuji，让警方以为犯人畏罪自杀，然后带走剩下的钱，但 Takuji 及时被 Conan 救下。Hiroyuki Tomonaga 企图带着剩余的赃款逃跑，但被 Conan（通过 Kogoro）抓住。随后 Ran 说 Tomonaga 没有这个资格，因为尽管是复制品，Tomonaga 却用那本精彩的立体书来犯罪，作者此刻一定在天堂为 Tomonaga 的所作所为而哭泣。
motive.en: He suggested Takuji Hirukawa to attack the transport truck carrying the money while making it look like he was out to avenge his brother. Victim: Takuji Hirukawa Age: 38 years old Injury: Explosion culprit: Hiroyuki Tomonaga Hiroyuki tried to make the police think the culprit commit suicide by killing Takuji via explosion and take the rest of the money but Takuji was saved at time by Conan. Hiroyuki Tomonaga attempted to flee with the remaining stolen money but was caught by Conan (via Kogoro). Then Ran said Tomonaga doesn't have the right to because despite being a copy Tomonaga used that wonderful picture book to commit crimes and the author must be crying in heaven now for what Tomonaga did.

method.zhHans: 作为证据，虽然炸弹装有定时器，但它们被改装成可用遥控器控制。随后 Ran 说 Tomonaga 没有这个资格，因为尽管是复制品，Tomonaga 却用那本精彩的立体书来犯罪，作者此刻一定在天堂为 Tomonaga 的所作所为而哭泣。

Then Ran said Tomonaga doesn't have the right to because despite being a copy Tomonaga used that wonderful picture book to commit crimes and the author must be crying in heaven now for what Tomonaga did.

evidence.zhHans: 作为证据，虽然炸弹装有定时器，但它们被改装成可用遥控器控制。Conan 开始怀疑 Tomonaga，因为他说作者把证据留给了他哥哥。这与“证据”只是一份复印件这一事实相矛盾，因为证据不可能套印错位。这只意味着 Tomonaga 仍然持有那份证据，并在案件过程中翻看过它，但他谎称自己读过。
evidence.en: As proof, though the bombs were equipped with timers, they were rigged to be controlled by a remote. Conan started suspecting Tomonaga when he said that the author left the proof for his brother. This was contradictory to the fact that the 'proof' was merely a photocopy, as it does not make sense for a proof to be misaligned. This only meant that Tomonaga still possessed the proof and had looked it through during the case, but he lied about reading it.

resolution.zhHans: 犯人是 Hiroyuki Tomonaga。作为证据，虽然炸弹装有定时器，但它们被改装成可用遥控器控制。据鉴定科称，这样只能在30米的范围内起作用。因此，犯人必须靠近炸弹才能加快定时器的速度。此外，犯人还必须把 incoming 的短信与 Kogoro 的动作协调一致。Tomonaga 自愿随警方前往以达成这一目的。他怂恿 Takuji Hirukawa 去袭击运载钞票的运输车，同时把自己伪装成在为哥哥报仇的样子。爆炸/杀人未遂地点：Haido/米花市？
